subject: Startups
title: Board Seats and Control
description: A 60-second lesson on Board Seats and Control.

hook.text: A founder gives up two board seats to investors. Now the board has three seats and the founder controls only one.

buildup.text: Board composition sets who has ultimate power: hiring the CEO, approving budgets, and greenlighting exits.

discovery.text: Mark Zuckerberg kept board control through dual-class shares.

twist.text: Most founders don't have Zuckerberg's leverage. By Series B, investors often control the board and can fire the CEO.

punchline.text: Equity is ownership. Board seats are power. They're different.

quiz.question: How did Zuckerberg maintain control of Facebook's board?
options: Through dual-class shares with superior voting rights
